name: A Tree Drinking From a River That Left

levels.entry: Thorn trees along the old channel, alive, in ground that has had no rain worth the name this year.
They are not doing it on rain. Something is reaching water and it is not the surface.
A washout has opened one root system. It goes down past where I can follow, straight, with no side branching at all.
No side roots means no water to find on the way. This tree is drinking from the depth the wells reach, and it is a slower version of the same argument.
The young ones are dying and the old ones are not. Whatever the root has to reach, it became too far to reach for a seedling somewhere inside a human lifetime.

notes: Botany doing the same dating work as the wells, from the other side. The detail that only the young die is the whole point.
